title: Large Pet Simulator 1 style zone gates replacing small red barriers
description: Replace the old small red ForceField gate between zones with large walkthrough archway gates like Pet Simulator 1. Two tall pillars (4x20x4), connecting arch on top, barrier in the middle that disappears when unlocked, BillboardGui with zone name and cost.
steps: Replace _spawnZoneGates() in ZoneService.lua with large gate construction (pillars, arch, barrier, billboard)
Remove old static ZoneGate_1_2 Part from generate_rbxlx.py build_workspace()
Add unlock particle/flash effect firing to client on gate unlock
acceptance_criteria: Two tall pillars (4x20x4 studs) are created left and right of the gate
An arch/beam connects the pillars on top
A semi-transparent reddish barrier exists when locked (CanCollide=true, Transparency=0.5)
BillboardGui shows next zone name and cost in large readable text
Touching the barrier when player has enough coins unlocks it (coins deducted)
On unlock: barrier disappears (CanCollide=false, Transparency=1), pillars and arch remain
Pillar color matches next zone theme
Gate is positioned exactly at the boundary between zones
Old small red gate system is fully removed
BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx is regenerated and valid XML
findings: Gate structure uses a Model container with named parts (LeftPillar, RightPillar, TopArch, GateBarrier)
GATE_PILLAR_COLORS table defined at module level for zone-themed pillar colors
Barrier uses Touched event - on unlock it sets CanCollide=false and Transparency=1 (no Destroy)
Pillars flash white via TweenService on unlock as visual feedback
ParticleEmitter spawned at barrier position for celebration burst
Static gate structure also placed in generate_rbxlx.py for the .rbxlx file representation
Gate opening width is 20 studs - wide enough for player to walk through comfortably
